topic: Crashing into an asteroid on purpose
script: In 2022, NASA crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid on purpose. The mission was called DART, and its target was a small moonlet named Dimorphos. The impact shortened Dimorphos's orbit by about 33 minutes. It was the first test of pushing an asteroid off course. Dimorphos was never a danger to Earth; it was a practice run.
